name: Pharaoh (Joseph's time)
title: King of Egypt who elevated Joseph
summary: This pharaoh ruled in Egypt during Joseph's time. After Joseph interpreted his dreams about the seven good years and the seven lean years, he appointed Joseph to govern all of Egypt to save the country through the famine.

keyEvents.title: Elevates Joseph
keyEvents.description: Pharaoh put Joseph in charge of all Egypt after he had interpreted the dreams about the famine.
